title: Clients
subtitle: Ein Client ist ein Engine-Build mit eigenen Dateien und Einstellungen. Geben Sie ihm einen Namen, und er gehört Ihnen.

list.heading: Ihre Clients
list.emptyText: Ein Client ist ein benannter Engine-Build mit eigenen Mods und Einstellungen. Legen Sie einen an, dann erscheint er hier.

list.otherGame_other: {{count}} Clients für {{game}} — wechseln Sie das Spiel in der Seitenleiste, um sie zu sehen.

card.manualInstall: Dieser Build muss von Hand installiert werden.

removeDialog.title: Delete {{client}}?
removeDialog.body: The whole folder of this client goes with it: the engine, the pk3 files installed into it and the settings of the game. Nothing is moved to the recycle bin, and this cannot be undone.
removeDialog.engine: The {{engine}} build inside it is deleted too and would have to be downloaded again.

enginePage.notFound: There is no engine with this id.
enginePage.factsExecutable: Runs {{file}} out of the client's own engine folder.
enginePage.factsModFolder: Starts in the {{folder}} mod folder, which a new client is given by itself.
enginePage.versionsText: The newest builds JKNet can install, newest first. Installing one is done from a client, not from here.
enginePage.versionsEmpty: The project publishes no archive JKNet can install.

openjk.compatible: Continues the official engine and keeps compatibility with the games and their mods.
openjk.noFeatures: Adds no features of its own and changes no balance: the project says so outright.
openjk.platforms: Runs on today's machines: x86-64, ARM and Apple Silicon, Windows, Linux and macOS.
openjk.stable: Jedi Academy single player and multiplayer are both stable.
openjk.outcast: Jedi Outcast multiplayer is not supported, and the project points at JK2MV for it.

eternaljk.japro: Brings the jaPRO changes into the engine and adds client-side work of its own.
eternaljk.release: Last tagged build is 1.5.8.5 of 2020-06-15, and servers still expect it.
eternaljk.sound: Crashes when the sound system is off. JKNet warns about s_initsound 0 before it starts the game.
eternaljk.steam: The project suggests renaming the executable to jamp.exe for Steam; JKNet starts it by its own name and does not need that.

taystjk.upstreams: Follows four projects at once: OpenJK, jaPRO, EternalJK and the Vulkan fork of EternalJK.
taystjk.competitive: Collects the quality of life work competitive servers ask for.
taystjk.wiki: Keeps its own feature list on the project site rather than in the repository.
taystjk.mission: States the same goals as OpenJK, in the same words.

jamme.what: Jedi Academy Movie Maker's Edition: the q3mme demo tools on an OpenJK of May 2013.
jamme.playback: Plays a demo under control: pause, seek, slow motion, a free camera and a chase camera.
jamme.capture: Captures video with motion blur, in stereo 3D or for VR, to mp4, avi, png, jpg or tga.
jamme.override: Overrides what the demo recorded: player name, saber colours and hilts, team, model, skies and textures.
jamme.mods: Reads demos of base, base_enhanced, ja+ and ja++, lugormod, makermod and PRMod.

jk2mv.versions: Multi Version: one executable plays all three retail builds of Jedi Outcast, 1.02, 1.03 and 1.04.
jk2mv.mods: Runs most Jedi Outcast mods — maps, skins and code — and part of the Jedi Academy assets.
jk2mv.modern: Modern resolutions, a widescreen interface, better gamma and the saber glow of the Jedi Academy engine.
jk2mv.downloads: Fast HTTP downloads, with a dialog before anything is fetched.
jk2mv.fixes: Fixes known security holes of the retail client and the EAX sound.
jk2mv.platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS and FreeBSD, on x86, x86-64 and ARM.

newDialog.title: Neuer Client
newDialog.text: Ein Client ist ein Engine-Build mit eigenen Dateien und Einstellungen. Geben Sie ihm einen Namen, den Sie in der Liste der Clients wiedererkennen.
newDialog.name: Name
newDialog.makeDefaultText: Die Schaltfläche Spielen im Bereich Start startet den Standard-Client des Spiels, auf dem sie steht. Jedes Spiel hat seinen eigenen.
newDialog.downloadText: Holt den neuesten Build von GitHub. Der Fortschritt erscheint auf der Karte des Clients.
newDialog.downloadSwitch: Engine gleich nach dem Anlegen des Clients herunterladen

clientWindow.notFound: There is no client with this id. It may have been deleted.
clientWindow.intro: These controls write into the launch arguments of this client. A control left empty writes nothing, and the engine keeps its own value.

client.heading: Client
client.name: Name
client.defaultHint: The Play button on Home starts the default client of this game. Each game has its own.
client.isDefault: Started by the Play button of {{game}}.
client.idHint: The folder on disk keeps its name <0>{{id}}</0>, so a rename cannot break a path the launcher already stored.
client.modFolderHint: Letters, digits, _, - and + only, and no path. Leave it empty for {{folder}}, the folder {{engine}} starts in.

video.heading: Video
video.sizeHint: The engine reads the width and the height in the Custom size mode only.

player.heading: Player
player.name: Player name (name)
player.hint: The name other players see. A server may refuse a name it already has.

performance.heading: Performance and network
performance.hint: Rate is bytes per second, snapshots is server updates per second.

extra.heading: Extra arguments
extra.label: Launch arguments
extra.hint: The whole command line of this client, the way a shortcut is written. The controls above edit this same line and leave everything else in it alone. Double quotes keep a value with a space together.

preview.heading: Command line preview
preview.text: What the engine gets when this client starts: the folders of the launcher, then the arguments of the Settings screen, then the ones above. A server address is added at connect time and is not shown here.

profiles.heading: Player profiles
profiles.intro: A profile is the name, the skin and the saber your character carries into the game. The default profile is the one Play and Connect start this client with.
profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Create one and this client starts with it.

removeDialog.title: Delete {{profile}}?
removeDialog.body: The nickname, the skin and the saber settings of this profile go with it. The client, its engine and its files stay as they are.

form.name: Profile name
form.nicknameHint: Up to 36 bytes, colour codes included. A Latin letter costs one byte and a Cyrillic one costs two, so 36 Latin letters fit where 18 Cyrillic ones do. Type ^ and a digit from 0 to 9 to colour what follows it.
form.nicknameTooLong: The server cuts a name over {{max}} bytes. Shorten it to save the profile.
form.skinLoading: Reading the archives of this client…
form.skinEmpty: No skin with an icon in the archives of this client.
form.saberEmpty: No hilt in the archives of this client.
form.saberLoading: Reading the hilts out of the archives…
form.tokens: What this profile adds to the command line
form.tokensEmpty: Nothing: a field left empty leaves the cvar to the engine.
form.tokensHint: Built from the fields above. Edit it to write the line yourself.
form.tokensOverrideHint: This line is yours and the fields no longer build it. The engine keeps the last +set of a cvar, so a cvar named twice ends on the second.
form.tokensOverrideNotice: This profile launches by the line at the bottom. The fields below still describe it, but they no longer reach the game until you reset the line.

missingToast.title: Noch kein Client für {{game}}
missingToast.text: Legen Sie einen an, dann startet dieses Spiel damit. Clients für {{game}} sind von denen des anderen Spiels getrennt.

launchWarning.title: Check the launch arguments
launchWarning.eternaljkSInitsound: EternalJK crashes when the sound system is disabled (s_initsound 0). Remove it from the launch arguments.
